key_concepts: Plants provide food such as vegetables, fruits, root crops, rice, and corn.
Leaves, seeds, fruits, and flowers of some plants can be eaten as vegetables.
Plants provide materials for making clothing, including cotton, ramie, abaca, and pineappl
Pineapple leaves are often used in making barong.
Many medicines come from plants, also called herbal or medicinal plants.
Guava leaves are used for washing wounds and for aromatic baths.
Guyabano leaves are used to cure stomach pain and diarrhea.
Oregano leaf juice is used for cough and asthma.
Lemongrass or tanglad can be used as mouthwash and to cure headache.
Some plants can be used as both food and medicine.
Ornamental and flowering plants are used for decoration and display.
